items.title: IBM's Gary Cohn on AI oversight: 'We want to inspire creativity again'
items.summary: IBM (IBM) Vice Chair Gary Cohn sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to talk about how government oversight of AI should both inspire and avoid stifling creativity in the US, and why regulation should focus on product outcomes rather than the underlying technology itself.

items.title: What Is Really Driving Palantir's Growth?
items.summary: Palantir Technologies (PLTR) is known for selling software to governments. Its fastest growth now comes from American companies. U.S. commercial revenue is what those American companies pay Palantir. That line reached $764 million in the latest quarter. It grew 149% from a year earlier. So what are American companies buying.

items.title: Verizon Commits $70 Million to Nationwide AI Training Initiative
items.summary: Verizon (NYSE:VZ) said it is investing $70 million in a nationwide initiative aimed at providing artificial intelligence training to job seekers, small businesses and educators in the United States. The telecommunications company is working with non-profit organisations including Goodwill Industries and aims to provide AI training to hundreds of thousands of people.

items.title: How To Size QBTS Stock For The Next Market Shock?
items.summary: D-Wave Quantum (QBTS) trades near $17.50, about 61% below the high it set inside the past year. Nothing in the market broke to do that. The S&P 500 returned close to 18% over the same twelve months. The stock has already fallen a shock-sized amount without a shock, which is what makes the next leg hard to size.

items.title: Can This Number Push IBM Stock Higher?
items.summary: The number worth watching at International Business Machines (IBM) is its annual recurring revenue. It kept growing through a weak quarter. You may expect the story here to be the missed second quarter or the falling stock. It is not. So how big is this recurring revenue business, and how fast is it growing.
